messages:
alice_ml: Quick smoke run results for structured output sampling across the new int8 canary and baseline fp16. Ran 3x batches of 500 queries with funcalls enabled. Short summary + one failing sample below.

ben_runtime: Thanks — what's the overall parse success & avg latency?

alice_ml: Parse success: 92% (int8), 98.6% (fp16). Funcall exact-match: 87% int8, 95% fp16. Avg p95 latency: 340ms int8, 290ms fp16. Token cost: int8 ~0.48 tokens/op vs 0.62.

carla_eval: Any pattern in failures? truncated JSON, extra text, or malformed fields?

alice_ml: Mostly suffix garbage and missing closing brace when KV cache prefixing occurs. Also ~12 samples emitted `{"action": null}` which our parser treats as no-op.

ben_runtime: Does this correlate with batch size or kvcache offsets?

alice_ml: Some correlation with long-history seeds. Re-running with prefix trimming decreased failures by ~3%. Also saw more failures when retry_budget=1.

dan_ops: What about retry policy? We currently use linear backoff 200ms x attempts.

alice_ml: We ran retries up to 2 with 200ms. Suggest trying exponential backoff 100->400ms and liberalize parse (soft-schema) as an experiment.

carla_eval: Can we add a small heuristic repair step: if trailing non-json detected, attempt regex to remove trailing garbage up to last '}' and reparse? That fixed ~40% of fails locally.

ben_runtime: Prefer runtime repair and retry over model changes. Proposed rollout: enable parsing-rescue + exp backoff on the int8 canary for 24h, measure funcall accuracy and latency.

alice_ml: Agreed. I'll run a narrow canary with parse-rescue + exp backoff and collect reflogs. ci-bot, can you schedule a job?

ci-bot: Job scheduled: eng-ml/structured-output-smoke/3073332100-run-1. Results due in ~2h.

dan_ops: Also tag infra — if p95 latency increases >20% we abort.

alice_ml: Action items: alice_ml -> run canary + parse-rescue; ben_runtime -> patch backoff config; carla_eval -> prepare evaluation harness to compute exact and soft-match metrics. I'll post interim stats in this thread.

Sample failing output (example):
```
{"id": "q-12345", "choices": [{"type": "func_call", "name": "get_price", "arguments": {"product_id": "abc123"}}
some trailing text unrelated to JSON
```

Notes: prefer minimal patches in runtime first. We'll collect per-query tokens, parse-success, funcall-exact, funcall-soft (normalized args), and p95 latency. If parse-rescue reduces fails >30% with <10% latency regression there's a path to enable for all int8 traffic.

alice_ml: Starting the run now — will update in ~2h with numbers.
